fontana_puncture.description: A solid cube with an oversized sphere subtracted (CSG, baked) so the void breaches every face - Fontana's Concetto Spaziale in 3D. A luminous point floats at the centre.

dna.default: breach=opened, strike=centred - the default pair is a SHORT-CIRCUIT, not a recomputation: _cut_radius() and _cut_offset() return the raw sphere_radius (0.34) and sphere_offset (ZERO) untouched at these values, so all 37 placements are bit-identical, including the 44 exhibit_furniture#mount:fontana_puncture plinth mounts and the 8 that embed interactive_point_origin_force. A placement that names sphere_radius or sphere_offset directly still wins over the named axis - the vocabulary is laid over the raw floats, never in place of them.
dna.was: sphere_radius and sphere_offset are this artifact's own declared critical_parameter and were reachable only as unnamed floats. 37 placements, every one showing the same 0.34 sphere: an artifact whose whole argument is that subtraction is generative, shipping exactly one subtraction.
dna.note: breach is not a size knob - cube_size stays 0.5 at every value, so the object keeps its cell and its footprint. The four values are the four topologically DISTINCT states of this geometry, cut against the cube's own critical distances (half-extent 0.5, edge-midpoint 0.707, corner 0.866 x cube_size): pierced 0.54 = six round mouths in solid matter (Fontana's buchi, dented through but not hollowed); opened 0.68 = shipped, 0.46 m mouths on a 0.5 m face and still connected, a thin frame; severed 0.74 = past the edge-midpoint, the twelve edges cut and the cube surviving as eight disconnected corner pieces, a different OBJECT not a smoother one; husk 0.80 = corners down to a twentieth of the extent. It stops short of 0.866 deliberately - past that the cube is gone and the frame measures NO RENDER, which is a fact about the capture and not about the art. strike is the paired direction axis (the same amount/direction split sphere_mid made with resolution/budget_bias); its three displaced values move on Y or on all three axes at once, so no single camera yaw can hide the axis behind the silhouette. The embedded point and the centre glint both ride the cut, so under strike the point that carved the void is still IN the void rather than buried in the surviving matter.
dna.declined: a third axis for WHAT the cutting tool is - a taglio (slash) against the buchi (holes) - is the obvious next promotion and is the artifact's own art-historical subject. It is not shipped because a slash is a cut in ONE face and the sweep photographs from a single fixed camera: half the yaws would show an uncut cube and the critic would report a fact about camera placement as a verdict on Fontana. Both axes shipped here are spherically or vertically legible, so no frame can lie about them.
dna.rebuild_guard: apply_grid_config previously tore down and rebuilt on ANY call. It now requires config_data.size() > 0, which preserves every real placement (all pass at least one key, and the 8 embedding ones need the rebuild) while removing the no-op reconfigure churn.

do_not_cross_barrier.name: Do Not Cross — Barrier
do_not_cross_barrier.description: A line you must not cross, rebuilt PROCEDURALLY - no glb, every mesh built in _ready(). Two forms as a declared axis: `sawhorse` (the New York police barricade - a straight wooden plank painted NYPD blue on A-frame legs, the legend stencilled white on both faces) and `tape` (two steel posts and a ribbon hung as a TRUE catenary, a*cosh(x/a) with the constant solved by Newton from span and sag - wave 17 published 'the catenary that is a parabola' as a defect, so a barrier shipped after that finding does not repeat it; measured honestly, at the default 0.18 m sag the catenary is 0.19 mm from the parabola, so the honesty is in the arithmetic, not the look). The legend is a PARAMETER now (legend_text), not baked geometry. Pairs with walk_this_line_marking, the floor half: the tape forbids crossing the line, the paint commands following it. Raised and shortened 2026-09-01: span_m 3.2 -> 2.2 (a prohibition you cannot see the end of is a wall, not a barrier) and a new height_m, default 1.15, deliberately TALLER than either form's natural height - an NYPD barricade is ~28 in because a body leans over it to argue with a cop. It now carries a box collider spanning floor to plank, not the plank alone, since a barricade you can walk between the legs of has forbidden nothing. #height_m:0 restores each form's measured height (0.71 sawhorse, 0.95 tape) and #solid:0 removes the body.

measurements.source: authored glTF, read from accessor bounds

dev_themes: the line as instrument of exclusion
do_not_cross_barrier.qfep_connection: Point_Lines argues that measure is also violence — what does not fit the grid is remainder, error, erased. This and its companion are that argument as furniture, standing in PERPENDICULAR relations to one line: the tape forbids crossing it, the paint commands following it.
do_not_cross_barrier.note: REBUILT 2026-08-19 from the glb-mounted version: commons/models/do_not_cross_line.glb is no longer referenced by any artifact (kept in the repo as the authored source). Config: #form:tape|sawhorse #span_m #legend_text #sag_m #shove_deg.
do_not_cross_barrier.label: Do Not Cross — Barrier

anamorphic_cross.name: Anamorphic Cross
anamorphic_cross.description: Two emissive bars, orthogonal, separated along -Z by depth_gap_m (2.6). An Area3D at the midpoint charges the player once on entry via arrive(), fading both bars to 0.85 transparency rather than deleting them - they stop pretending rather than vanish. Health is reached BY CAPABILITY (/root/GameManager, else the 'health_provider' group, else nothing) and never by class name, so the artifact compiles under a SceneTree probe. Signals crossed(cost), dissolved(). Knobs: depth_gap_m, bar_len_m, cross_height_m, damage, trigger_radius_m, bar_color.
anamorphic_cross.theoreticalGrounding: Point_Lines' perspective paragraph as an object you can walk around: 'here parallels meet after all - not because they stopped being parallel, but because you are standing somewhere.' The corridor IS the standpoint, which is what makes this more than a trick - you cannot fail to see the cross, and walking, the only thing a corridor asks of you, is exactly what destroys it. The instrument is used up by being used. The room does not take the cross away; geometry does. What the room adds is that arriving COSTS something, so the thing that existed only at a distance charges you for closing it. One rung past the barrier and the laser: measure, point, strike, and now a shape that is only a shape from where you were told to stand.
anamorphic_cross.label: Anamorphic Cross

wall_abstract.name: Wall Abstract
wall_abstract.description: Fifteen framed abstract works for a wall. Four hard divisions (horizontal, vertical, diagonal, off-centre) and one soft one (horizon_soft, a vertex-colour gradient with no edge at all). Three states of the corpus's first argument: point_one, two_points, segment_drawn. The chapter's fork as a pair: grid_regular against trace_once. corner_square for asymmetry. Three live SubViewport windows - cube_isometric, cube_wire, sphere_raking. And chalk, the blackboard principle at painting scale.

dna.predicted_degeneracy: The closest pair will be point_one against corner_square: the same pale ground with one small dark mark on it, differing only in where the mark sits and that one is 0.055 of the width and the other 0.15. Both marks together cover well under 3 percent of the face, and the face is about 60 percent of frame, so the differing pixels are roughly 1.5 percent. Runner-up is two_points against segment_drawn, which differ by one thin bar of 0.42 x 0.008 - about 0.35 percent of the face. A LOWER BOUND like every prediction here: if the sweep returns BELOW these, suspect the harness, not the axis. The set is deliberately built to contain near-twins, because point_one / two_points / segment_drawn are one artifact in three states and the corpus's first argument is that the difference between them is small to look at and total to think about.
dna.bench_caveat: THE GALLERY TILE FOR cube_isometric IS A FALSE NEGATIVE. build_dna_gallery waits about 3 frames and a nested SubViewport has not drawn by then, so that variant photographs as a flat grey panel there. It is not inert and the value is not dead: probe_wall_window.gd found 15 distinct colours in the render target at frame 12, and probe_wall_abstract_sheet.gd at frame 22 photographs the cube plainly. Anyone reading a low bite on this axis should shoot it with a settle before concluding anything - the same class of error as the MultiMesh readback that reported queer_confetti static when it was moving.

wall_abstract.theoreticalGrounding: Palle, 2026-09-01: 'I think 3d in 2d and 2d in 3d ... on the wall works panel where there now is text I also want abstract works.' The recursion is the system. The FRAME is 3D - real moulding with depth casting a real shadow. The WORK is 2D - a flat face, no depth, the oldest lie in painting. And one work is 3D AGAIN inside its own 2D: cube_isometric is a live camera on a cube that exists, just not in this room. A visitor walking past sees a picture; closer, sees that one of the pictures is a window; walking round, sees the cube is not there. That is 3d-in-2d and 2d-in-3d as one object rather than two, and the museum needs no new machinery to hang it. The orthographic camera matters: perspective would make it a photograph of a cube, orthographic makes it a DRAWING of one, which is the register the rest of the wall is in.
wall_abstract.label: Wall Abstract

axis_line.name: Axis Line
axis_line.description: A single emissive bar of length_m x thickness_m, positioned at cross_height_m and rotated about Z by the orientation axis: horizontal 0, vertical 90, diagonal +45, diagonal_2 -45. Knobs: orientation, length_m, thickness_m, cross_height_m, line_color, glow.

dna.predicted_degeneracy: The closest pair will be diagonal against diagonal_2: the same bar mirrored, so from the canonical camera at yaw 0.62 they differ only by which way the slash leans. Two bars of 1.6 x 0.055 crossing the frame at +/-45 overlap over their central region and diverge at the ends; by area that is roughly 2 x (half the bar drawn in a different place) over the frame, call it 5 percent. A LOWER BOUND, as every prediction in this corpus has been - the rasteriser has one light and no shadows. If the sweep comes back BELOW 5 percent, something is wrong with the harness, not the axis.

axis_line.theoreticalGrounding: Palle left four wishes standing in Point_Lines - horizontal line, vertical line, diagonal line, diagonal line 2 - and they are not four artifacts. They are one artifact and one axis, which is the room's own argument: a line has a direction, the direction is a CHOICE, and horizontal and vertical are two picks out of infinitely many that a culture happens to have named and squared its buildings against. Shipping them as four tokens would say the opposite, that `vertical` is a kind of thing rather than a value. Point_Lines' text already makes the claim in words - 'Horizontal and vertical are the same function with the indices swapped. Space does not have a preferred axis; the code does, and only because someone wrote y first' - and this is the same sentence as geometry.
axis_line.label: Axis Line

street_talker.name: Street Talker
street_talker.description: Two leaning planks (scuffed dark wood) hinged at the top on a brass-grey bar, standing on two feet. Each face carries a TextScreen in SCREEN mode, so wrapping, truncation and the minimum legible glyph are the screen component's problem and not this artifact's. Front: 'HERE YOU CAN' over the room's subject, plus a line counting the descents on the back. Back: 'GOES DEEPER' over each glimpsed thing's plaque line with its optional inscription indented beneath. Knobs: board_height, board_width, lean_degrees, frame_color, hinge_color, map_name (else the hall is found by walking up the tree).

dna.fixture_why: This artifact builds NOTHING until it knows which hall it stands in, because an empty A-frame in the 243 rooms with no depth ruling would advertise, in every one of them, that somebody meant to say something and did not. That gate is the design, so the capture bench has to be told which hall to photograph it in rather than the gate being loosened for the bench's convenience. Point_One is the one ruled room, so it is the only hall where a photograph of this sign shows anything at all.

street_talker.theoreticalGrounding: A learner is thrown into a running system — computer, OS, engine, scene, node, coordinate space — and there is no arriving early enough to hold all of it. Treating every dependency as a prerequisite has no bottom (before Vector3, floats; before floats, binary; before binary, electricity) and leaves nothing taught about points; hiding every dependency leaves unexplained magic. The gradient is the third option: explain a dependency when ignorance of it prevents the intended mental model, and not merely because it exists. THE A-FRAME MAKES THAT PHYSICAL. It stands on public ground on the visitor's side of the threshold, provisional and moveable, so what it says reads as a judgment someone made rather than the building's settled account. And its two faces separate the offer from the demand: the front is met by walking in, the back only by walking round, so the descent is genuinely declinable and declining costs nothing and looks like nothing. A single panel cannot do this — it either shows both, making the descent compulsory, or hides it, making it a secret.
street_talker.label: Street Talker

grabbable_line.description: A line segment you grab as one object — pick up anywhere along its length to move it through space. Fixed length, visible endpoints, integer-resistance glitch. Complements the endpoint-first line by teaching whole-before-parts.
grabbable_line.name: Grabbable Line
grabbable_line.qfep_connection: Holding a line whole before decomposing it into endpoints — unity precedes analysis, the body grasps the relation before the mind names the parts.

dna.default: grain=solid - PRESERVES all 16 placements exactly. _build_grain() returns on the first line when grain is solid: no node is added, no property is written, nothing is hidden, and _layout_parts() walks an empty array. The rod, the two endpoint beads, the label, the capsule collider and the glitch loop are the same objects in the same places as before promotion. The metadata read added to _ready only fires when a token carries #grain:, and apply_grid_config now returns without touching anything when the word has not moved - which is what cluster_resolver and curation_station hand it.
dna.was: one unbroken rod with two endpoint beads, in sixteen rooms, with no way to ask what a line is made of - which is the artifact's own truth line ('a line is one thing made of two points') standing as its own contradiction
dna.note: hand promotion 2026-08-03, after the runner refused it as having no turnable knobs. It has exports, but they are a length, a thickness, a radius and four resistance numbers: sizes self-cancel under an AABB-fitted camera and the resistance is a RATE - jitter, a detuning noise loop, haptics - which a still frame cannot photograph. So the sizes and the rate were demoted and the question underneath was built instead. Every rung is standing geometry with no randf in it, and every rung keeps the same +/-line_length/2 envelope, so only the mass inside the silhouette changes.
dna.shares_vocabulary_with: grain is taken character for character from cube_scene and prism_block - solid|split|quartered|lattice|shell, the project's one word for how finely a body is made of parts - and the five rungs land exactly on a 1-D body: split is one cut, quartered is three, lattice is eleven on a regular pitch, and shell is the boundary, which for a segment is literally its two endpoints (d[a,b] = {a,b}) as the cube's shell is its twelve edges. The siblings should measure alike on solid->split, which is one gap appearing in one body in both cases.
dna.declined: readout (none|numeral|gradation|lattice), carried by the siblings line, line_interface and xyz_slider_plate. Rungs 0 and 1 fit - this artifact prints '%.2fm' over its midpoint - but rung 3 does not. On line.gd, lattice means the privileged whole numbers on the LENGTH scale, because its resistance fires on the distance between two dragged handles. Here resistance fires on global_position: the whole numbers this artifact privileges are stations in the ROOM, not readings on a rule. Painting a hot collar on the length scale would put the law where it does not live, so the word was declined rather than half-taken.
dna.measurement_risk: a thin subject. The rod is 16 mm across on a 240 mm span while the two endpoint beads are 36 mm and emissive, so the beads own most of the bright pixels and every divided rung changes only the rod. Expect solid->split to read faint by dilution rather than by inertness; crop-recheck before believing it. shell (rod gone, beads only) and lattice (twelve ticks) are the rungs that change the silhouette, and they are the axis's real evidence.

grabbable_line.label: Grabbable Line

line_relations_gallery.name: Line bodies and relations
line_relations_gallery.description: Five off-white podiums present horizontal, vertical, parallel, plus and X arrangements: equal pink segments with white spherical endpoints. Crossings have a visible depth gap. A shared material plinth holds a wooden plank, rod, pink light and ruler. All line bodies remain grabbable. Planar and spatial grids, seven leaning planks and the entrance ceiling-alignment study remain. FOLLOW THIS LINE starts in the open centre, crosses the floor, climbs a solid two-metre column, crosses its top and returns down the far side to the floor.
line_relations_gallery.label: Line bodies and relations

laser_exploding_sphere.description: Grabbable sphere that explodes into particles when hit by a laser pointer. 40 particle burst with procedural explosion sound. VR target practice.
laser_exploding_sphere.name: Laser Exploding Sphere
laser_exploding_sphere.qfep_connection: A grabbable sphere that bursts into forty particles when a laser finds it — the primitive granted mortality. The one shape in the room you can destroy, its explosion a small argument that even ideal geometry, once embodied, can be undone.

dna.default: moment=intact - PRESERVES all 13 placements exactly. _build_moment() returns on its first line: no node is added, no property is written, nothing is hidden, and _is_exploding stays false, so the sphere is the same live target on collision layer 21 that it was before promotion. The metadata read added to _ready only fires when a token carries #moment:, and apply_grid_config (new - the artifact had none) returns without touching anything when the word has not moved, which is what cluster_resolver and curation_station hand it.
dna.was: one emissive ball that could only ever be photographed intact. Everything the artifact owns happens in a tenth of a second, once, and only after a laser ray touches it - which never happens during a capture - and then it queue_free()s itself, so in a live map the aftermath exists for one second and never again.
dna.note: hand promotion 2026-08-03, after the runner refused it as having no turnable knobs. Its four exports are a count, a speed, a duration and a colour; three describe particles that do not exist while the shutter is open, so sweeping any of them would have produced N identical photographs of an intact sphere and a confident INERT verdict about a design that was never in the frame. The axis is therefore not a parameter of the event but WHICH MOMENT OF THE EVENT IS STANDING IN THE ROOM. The explosion's own constants - explosion_particle_count pieces, the same 0.02 m fragment the live burst spawns - are lifted out of the tween nobody sees and set down as geometry that holds still. intact is the promise, fissured the flaw already in it (three dark seams girdling the ball; it still explodes), burst the event held at full throw, scattered the residue settled on the floor. The @identity's own emerges line says the reset 'reveals that destruction here is a demonstration, not a consequence'; a map can now put the room in any of four tenses instead of only the first.
dna.still_note: four silhouettes, not four scales: a solid ball, a ball with three dark great circles cut across it, a hollow sphere of forty points, a flat disc of dimmed debris. burst and scattered deliberately differ in KIND rather than radius, because an AABB-fitted camera normalises size and two fragment fields at two radii would photograph identically - the trap that makes a real axis read inert. No randf() anywhere in the frozen fields (Fibonacci sphere, golden-angle disc), so two captures of one value are two photographs of one object; the live explosion keeps its random directions untouched.
dna.behaviour_change: burst and scattered set _is_exploding at build time, so the existing guard at the top of hit_by_laser() makes them inert to the pointer - a thing that has already gone off does not go off again. intact and fissured are live targets and explode exactly as before. The collider is never altered at any value.
dna.measurement_risk: intact -> fissured is the quiet step: the silhouette is identical and only the skin changes, three 4 mm seams on a 200 mm ball. Expect it low and read it as a surface-level change rather than an inert axis; the axis's loud evidence is burst and scattered. If burst reads faint, check subject % first - the fragment shell is 0.56 m of mostly empty space and the fitter will pull back, shrinking every piece in frame.

laser_exploding_sphere.label: Laser Exploding Sphere

line_sledgehammer.name: Line Sledgehammer
line_sledgehammer.description: Pickable RigidBody3D built on res://addons/godot-xr-tools/objects/pickable.tscn. Cylindrical haft (0.86 m, wood) with a steel box head (0.28 m) carrying a spherical Area3D strike volume that masks bit 21 and bit 1, monitoring both bodies and areas — areas because a wall showing has no collider by contract and would otherwise be unhittable. Head speed is measured per physics frame; below HEAD_SPEED_MIN (1.15 m/s) nothing happens, and a landed strike sets a 0.45 s cooldown so one swing is one strike. Emits struck(target, speed). Knobs: haft_m, head_len_m, head_color, haft_color, was_a_line.

dna.fixture_why: A RigidBody3D under gravity. capture_multi_angle measured the AABB correctly (0.28 x 0.925 x 0.13) and then photographed empty grass, because the multi-angle run spans enough frames for the hammer to fall out of shot. The fixture holds it still for the bench. It is not a lie about the object: a hammer in a hand is not falling either.

line_sledgehammer.theoreticalGrounding: Point_Lines argues that a line which measures and a line which destroys are one technique in two situations: 'Pointing and destroying are not two techniques; they are one technique and two situations, and the line cannot tell them apart. Nothing in the vector records the difference.' A wall label can assert that. This is the assertion becoming a mechanic — the same line you adjusted the length of, ninety seconds later, in your hand, in front of a police barrier. The escalation the room describes (two points, a distance, a segment, a direction, pointing, the drag, scale, destroy) has its last two rungs here rather than in prose. Crucially the hammer invents NO private way to break things: it reuses laser_exploding_sphere's existing contract, so a target never knows which instrument arrived, which is the claim restated as an implementation fact.
line_sledgehammer.label: Line Sledgehammer

sketch_monitor.description: A monitor standing in the room that runs a Processing-style 2D sketch — a SubViewport canvas on an unshaded screen, so the flat world and its own coordinate system stand inside the round one. First sketch: moving scan lines, a raster showing you what a raster is. A new example is a Sketch subclass and one line.
sketch_monitor.name: sketch_monitor
sketch_monitor.label: sketch_monitor

dna.default: housing=stand + surface=plane is the legacy lineage; uv1 scale/offset resolve to StandardMaterial3D's own defaults.
dna.note: CORRECTED 2026-07-27. This block first shipped with FABRICATED values (housing none|bezel|hooded|cabinet, surface flat|curved|tiles|frosted) that were never in the code's @export_enum. Nothing failed loudly: the sweep set an invalid value, the artifact fell back to its default, 16 identical frames were published, and the critic measured them and called the axis INERT at 0.69% focus. The declaration was wrong, not the design. Only 'tiles' survived, because it happens to appear in both lists, which is why surface scored a nonzero 0.29% instead of zero. A fabricated declaration produces a complete-looking experiment whose verdict is secretly about the registry. tools/check_dna_declarations.py now diffs every declared axis against its code enum, and build_dna_gallery.py refuses to sweep one that fails. The face is wrapped in a Face Node3D; GridInteractablesComponent._compute_local_aabb recurses into Node3D children and multiplies by their transform, so grounding is unaffected.

science_screen.description: Cased 2D instruments in 3D with stand, frame, cabinet and pylon supports. Explicit mode:voxel_slice reads its own hall lattice source and compares one horizontal biased-field section with the actual occupied/empty decisions, without substituting data when the source is absent.
science_screen.name: Science Screen
science_screen.qfep_connection: Transformation here is projection: a 3D state is re-expressed in 2D while preserving selected structural relations. It shows how representation changes without becoming arbitrary.
science_screen.capacity: COMPARE a 3D artifact with its 2D abstraction and see what structure survives projection.
interactions: bring a grid-aware artifact near the screen
compare the embodied 3D object with its flat rendering
read algorithm labels and cell statistics on the display
use the screen to reflect on what projection keeps and discards
science_screen.label: Science Screen

wall_health_station.name: Wall Health Station
wall_health_station.description: Wall box (0.34 x 0.44 x 0.14) with a red cross and a TextScreen face showing remaining charge or EMPTY. An Area3D of reach_m counts occupants and draws rate_per_sec while anyone stands there. draw_from(want) asks the provider back after setting, because set_health CLAMPS - so charge is debited by what ACTUALLY arrived, and a full body costs the wall nothing. Health by capability, never by class name. Signals drew(amount, charge_left), emptied(). Knobs: charge, rate_per_sec, reach_m, body_color, trim_color.
wall_health_station.theoreticalGrounding: The citation matters and is kept exact. Half-Life's wall charger is not a floor pickup: you stand at a fixed place, it drains while it fills you, and its supply runs out. That makes the room decide what your body is worth, which is the reason a corridor is a corridor and not a scoreboard. Paired with anamorphic_cross, which takes 15 for walking into a shape that was never there, this station holds exactly five arrivals - after which the corridor still charges and there is nothing on the wall. That is the only honest ending for a machine that dispenses relief.
wall_health_station.label: Wall Health Station

laser_measure.description: Handheld laser distance measurement tool with LCD display
laser_measure.name: laser_measure
laser_measure.qfep_connection: The handheld ruler with an LCD conscience: point, and the world answers in meters. Measurement as a portable act — the abstraction of the line turned into a tool you carry, distance no longer a property of two points but a question you can ask anywhere.
laser_measure.label: laser_measure

line_space_workshop.description: Four live filmed studies of two, three, four and more line segments. Animated 3D geometry lives in a private filming world; only four tilted 2D monitors appear in the museum. Monochrome, ink threshold, contour and scan-line images; fixed frontal, oblique and slowly orbiting cameras. Six-second holds, five-second rigid movements and a closed four-edge fold. No exposed rods, grab targets or buttons.
line_space_workshop.name: Line Space Workshop
line_space_workshop.qfep_connection: A crossing in an image can conceal separation in depth. Moving a segment or changing viewpoint exposes which relations belong to the arrangement and which to the observer.
line_space_workshop.label: Line Space Workshop

two_point_ruler.name: Two Point Ruler
two_point_ruler.description: Two brass marks 0.5 m apart on a thin bar at reading height, a TextScreen readout above, and two blocks on the floor: Subject (pale, measured, never altered) and Witness (blue, unmeasured, scaled by every reading, labelled 'the other block'). measure() returns the reading in metres and tweens the witness; the witness clamps to [0.18, 2.4] so it can never leave — a witness scaled to nothing is one that has gone, and the argument needs it present to be watched. Signals measured(reading_m, witness_scale). Knobs: unit_m, spread_m, subject_color, witness_color, rule_color.
two_point_ruler.theoreticalGrounding: The instrument reads the pale subject and separately changes the blue witness. This is an authored causal coupling: measurement does not inherently require another body to shrink. The visitor can compare the stable reading with the changing witness, repeat the action, and inspect the distinct instructions. Attention may miss the side effect, but looking toward the witness does not disable measurement. A unit enables comparison while the surrounding program decides what follows from using it.
two_point_ruler.label: Two Point Ruler

dna.default: vanishing_points=one, reach=touch - every endpoint forced to Vector3.ZERO at full travel, wearing the single shipped colour (1.0, 0.3, 0.5), which is literally the code that has always run, so all 10 existing placements are pixel-identical
dna.was: the shared origin is this artifact's own declared critical_parameter and it was a literal Vector3.ZERO, with the four frame corners, the 0.008 thickness and the pink all inlined in setup_perspective_lines() and no apply_grid_config() at all. The piece could state one-point perspective and nothing else - it could not say that a vanishing point belongs to a family of parallels rather than to the world.
dna.note: vanishing_points is not a count of lines - the scene still has exactly four, and at every value they still run from the same rectangular frame. What changes is how many origins those four are forced to share, which is the whole claim. In two- and three-point modes the lines are tinted by family so you can see which parallels answer to which point; in one-point mode all four keep the shipped colour, so the default is untouched. reach answers the identity line that calls the vanishing point 'a limit, not a place' - the shipped drawing contradicted it by letting the cylinders arrive and stop.

perspective_lines.description: all lines → (0,0,0) — convergence to a single vanishing point as perspective law
perspective_lines.name: perspective_lines
perspective_lines.qfep_connection: All lines running to one point — the vanishing point, perspective's single law. The Renaissance's most consequential primitive: the discovery that depth on a flat surface is just convergence, that space can be faked by a ruler aimed at infinity. The line taught to lie about distance, and the whole illusion of the third dimension riding on that one honest trick.
perspective_lines.label: perspective_lines

two_points_line.description: Two luminous endpoints and the segment between them - Euclid's first postulate. Different-coloured points with a messenger travelling A<->B so the line reads as a live channel of relation.
two_points_line.name: Two Points Line
two_points_line.qfep_connection: A line is the first relation in geometry - relation, not substance. Collapse is A=B; the move is difference held apart and bridged without being erased.
two_points_line.label: Two Points Line

hand_telemetry_diptych.description: Two Half-Life-2 / Combine-style ops monitors side by side on one grey pipe-clamp mount - a diptych. The LEFT panel (cyan) streams the left hand's live world position, the RIGHT panel (orange) the right hand's, each a scrolling coordinate log. The tracked body split down the middle and read in stereo. Composes two hand_telemetry_display panels.
hand_telemetry_diptych.name: Hand Telemetry Diptych
hand_telemetry_diptych.qfep_connection: You were never watched as a whole, only as a set of hands, each on its own bright channel. The diptych is honest about the plural: a fully captured body is just a list of points, one feed per part.
hand_telemetry_diptych.label: Hand Telemetry Diptych

film_foundation_trace.name: Read a candidate. Keep a position. Join a pair.
film_foundation_trace.description: Eight given positions become a retained list by the exact distance >=0.8 m test. The learner reads candidates and separately joins retained neighbours, with both route and stored list visible in 3D.
interactions: Look at the screen to play.
Pause, replay, step or turn the view.
Use the lower row to try the model; the demonstration pauses.
Your choices remain when you look away. DEMO returns to the demonstration.
film_foundation_trace.qfep_connection: Fixed candidates from the browser study, not live hand tracking or a replay of a museum drawing. Two-dimensional source positions are embedded on a 3D table with equal units; joining does not alter those positions.
film_foundation_trace.label: Read a candidate. Keep a position. Join a pair.

plan_vitrine.name: Plan vitrine
plan_vitrine.description: An enterable glass room around a five-by-five numbered plan. The panes have no colliders; the plan has a continuous floor. With active VR controllers, entry mounts two drawing pens and exit removes them. The space_grid pair compares a freely sampled cyan trace with an amber trace rounded to local one-metre X/Z addresses, retaining hand height. The legacy space_time pair compares spatial drawing with a time-domain trace. Desktop visitors can walk the plan but receive no mounted pens. Marks linger briefly after exit.
plan_vitrine.qfep_connection: Two recording rules admit different movements into their traces. In Grid the floor supplies shared addresses while the hand can still move within them; what a record retains becomes available for comparison.
interactions: walk in through any face; the lit opening shows the intended front
VR only: both controllers gain a draw_dot on entry and lose it on exit

parameters.span_m: Outer face to outer face, metres (default 5.0, matching simulation_grid's walkable collider)
parameters.wrap_plan: Build simulation_grid inside the box (default true)
parameters.linger_s: Seconds the marks hang after the visitor steps out (default 6.0)
parameters.left_ink: Ink name for the free pen: magenta, cyan, amber, lime, white (default cyan)
parameters.right_ink: Ink name for the right-hand pen (default amber)
parameters.pen_pair: space_time (legacy default) or space_grid (Point_Line_Grid: sampled space / local one-metre X/Z rounding, continuous height)

plan_vitrine.capacity: DRAW with two incompatible pens at once
plan_vitrine.label: Plan vitrine

grab_sphere_point_snap.description: snap(position) = round(position / grid_size) * grid_size — discretise continuous space
grab_sphere_point_snap.name: grab_sphere_point_snap
grab_sphere_point_snap.qfep_connection: Your analog hand against round(position / grid_size): the sphere follows you continuously, then clicks to the nearest lattice point, and the trail records which differences survived. Quantization felt as a series of small verdicts on your movement.
grab_sphere_point_snap.label: grab_sphere_point_snap

dna.default: grammar=organic, depth=5 - a no-op on both. organic returns the shipped direction rule verbatim (prefer the longer axis at a 1.3 tolerance, _rng.randf() > 0.5 when near square) and the shipped position rule verbatim (lo + _rng.randi_range(0, hi - lo)), so the RNG is consumed in the same order and the same amount and seed 73 draws the same partition it always drew; depth is the old split_depth export under the family's word, and 5 is the number it shipped with. None of the 8 placements passes a config dict at all - they are bare tokens or rotation/offset shorthand, which the grid routes to overrides and not to config_data - so _apply_artifact_config is never even called for them. apply_grid_config now regenerates only when a value actually DIFFERS and only after _ready has built once.
dna.was: no axis. The registry called this a shape grammar and the grammar was not a parameter: the split rule lived as three unnamed decisions inside _bsp_split (prefer the longer axis, 1.3 tolerance, cut anywhere in the legal band), and split_depth was a plain int export with no config key the map layer routes. The only thing about a shape grammar that was ever variable was the seed - which changes the sample, not the rule.
dna.note: hand promotion 2026-08-03, refused by the runner for NO TURNABLE KNOBS. The four new productions were written against the partition this file already draws (min_room_size still binds, walls and doors and the area-tint are untouched) and each argues a different BUILDING: alternating cuts strictly by recursion level, the textbook BSP, and comes out as nested bands; symmetric bisects the legal band and comes out equal-roomed, a barracks; golden cuts at 0.382 and comes out proportioned, a villa; corridor cuts hard against the minimum, shaving one min_room_size cell off every division, so the plan reads as a spine with cells hanging off it. Three of the five consume no RNG for the cut position, which is correct - a deterministic production is a fact rather than a sample. THE DEPTH LADDER WAS CHECKED, NOT ASSUMED: the partition was re-implemented in Python and run 400 times per rung, giving mean leaf counts 2.00 / 3.75 / 6.81 / 11.25 / 16.56 for depth 1..5 and zero identical partitions between adjacent rungs, so the ladder does not saturate against min_room_size before it runs out. Declared 1-5 and not 1-6 because 5 is the shipped value and the top of the @export_range. SEED IS DELIBERATELY NOT AN AXIS: a seed ladder is five samples of one rule, which is the picture this artifact already had and the reason it read as un-promoted.
dna.kin: lsystem_dungeon.grammar (warren|spiral|branch|meander) and lsystem_dungeon.depth (1-4) ask exactly these two questions of the other top-down plan generator in the corpus, and both WORDS are taken from there unchanged - which production is run, and how many times. The VALUE lists are not shared and must not be: lsystem_dungeon rewrites a string and its four values name turtle topologies, while this file recursively divides a rectangle and its five name where the knife goes. Calling a BSP production 'meander' would make two artifacts look like siblings that measure alike when the only thing they share is that the result is a floor plan. space_filling_curve_gallery.depth names its rungs (sketch|sparse|standard|fine) because it samples one fixed curve; here, as in lsystem_dungeon, the honest unit is the cut itself, so the rungs are integers.

room_grammar.description: Shape grammar for architectural floor plans â€” binary space partitioning recursively splits a rectangle into rooms, draws wall outlines, adds door gaps, and colors rooms by area. The algorithmic foundation behind roguelike dungeon generation.
room_grammar.name: Room Grammar
room_grammar.label: Room Grammar

street_sign.name: Street Sign
street_sign.description: Octagonal STOP sign on a galvanized pole with a foot plate - red face, white rim, 'STOP' text. sign_sides reshapes it (8=octagon STOP, 4=diamond warning, 3=yield, ~32=circle). The civic grammar of halt.

parameters.direction: Geometric arrow instead of text: none, left, right, ahead, both (default none)

street_sign.label: Street Sign

rock_spawner.description: Spawns multiple irregular rocks with physics - demonstrates packing inefficiency and gaps
rock_spawner.name: Rock Spawner
rock_spawner.qfep_connection: Thirty seeded irregulars dropped from three and a half metres and left to the solver: the gaps in the settled pile are the lesson. Spheres would pack and boxes would stack — these can't, and the leftover voids are what individuality costs in storage, entropy made legible as trapped air.
rock_spawner.label: Rock Spawner

rock_scanner.description: Dimensional scanner - reveals 2D cross-sections of 3D irregular forms, showing how dimensionality affects perception
rock_scanner.name: Rock Scanner
rock_scanner.qfep_connection: The plane sweeps and the display renders each rock's slice as a filled circle computed from its bounding sphere — a comment in the code admits the substitution as 'simpler and more reliable.' An instrument of dimensional honesty with an idealizing core: the cross-section of the irregular drawn as the one shape no rock has.
rock_scanner.label: Rock Scanner

concrete_barrier.name: Concrete Barrier
concrete_barrier.description: Jersey / K-rail concrete traffic barrier - a tapered stepped profile wrapped in weathered red/white diagonal hazard stripes, with two steel lifting hooks. The architecture of forbidden passage; the hooks mark it as temporary.

parameters.stripe_color_a: Hazard stripe color A (default weathered red)
parameters.show_hooks: Bool - steel lifting hooks on top (default true)
parameters.blocking: Add a static convex-hull collider on layer 1 (default false; map config #blocking:1)

concrete_barrier.label: Concrete Barrier

diamonds.description: Stacks rotating solids into a twisting tower. DNA: twist_rule selects HOW the angle accumulates up the stack (linear=the helix, fixed=no accumulation, alternating=braid between two orientations, accelerating=same total twist reached superlinearly); unit selects which solid the rule acts on. Config: #twist_rule:fixed#unit:tetrahedron

dna.default: twist_rule=linear, unit=octahedron - the exact pre-promotion construction (rotation.y = rotation_offset * i on stacked octahedron.tscn), so the 11 existing placements are unchanged
dna.was: the artifact's own truth statement says the RULE is more fundamental than the result, and the rule was the one thing hard-coded: rotation_offset * i, linear accumulation, stated once and never varied. The four exports it did have (unit_count, unit_size, unit_height, rotation_offset) only changed how big the same claim was, which is why the sweep read it as having no turnable knobs.
dna.note: The two axes are a control pair: twist_rule varies the rule with the unit held, unit varies the unit with the rule held. fixed is the null hypothesis the docstring already named — every unit turned by the same amount, no accumulation, no helix. accelerating reaches the same total twist at the top as linear by a different path, so the endpoints agree and the form does not.

diamonds.name: diamonds
diamonds.qfep_connection: Octahedra stacked and rotated into a twisting tower — the single primitive multiplied into sculpture. The chapter's quiet thesis made ornamental: give one regular solid a rule for repeating and it grows a spire nobody carved.
diamonds.label: diamonds

cube_lines.name: cube_lines
cube_lines.qfep_connection: Twelve thin lines and no faces: the cube reduced to its adjacency, an inventory of edges showing the volume was always an inference the eye supplies.

dna.default: disclosure=frame, coding=uniform - all twelve edges drawn at thickness 0.008 in Color(0.4, 0.8, 1.0), which is the exact shipped call, so the 3 existing placements render byte for byte as before
dna.was: twelve edges, one blue, always - the registry's own line about the volume being an inference the eye supplies was stated at only one volume of speech and so could not be argued with
dna.note: the twelve edge positions are identical for every value of both axes; disclosure only decides which edges are drawn, coding only their tint. Nothing is added to the scene and nothing moves.

cube_lines.label: cube_lines

film_cube_corner.description: Eight source vertices become the cube; moving corner 6 reveals the unchanged front diagonal.
interactions: Look at the screen to play.
Pause, replay, step or turn the view.
film_cube_corner.qfep_connection: Actual builder vertices, triangle indices and mesh update function. Construction timing and materials are staged.
film_cube_corner.label: The diagonal was already there

first_shadow.name: First Shadow
first_shadow.description: One hand-built triangle (three vertices, the smallest surface the engine accepts) casting the room's first real shadow, beside a line that casts none. Primitives taxonomy, Triangle rung, 2026-08-27.
first_shadow.label: First Shadow

first_phosphor.name: First Phosphor
first_phosphor.description: The medium's nativity as an altar piece: one oscilloscope on a lab cart, black velvet shroud, and on the dark glass ONE green phosphor dot - breathing with persistence, blinking at the cursor's 530 ms cadence. Tennis for Two 1958, Spacewar 1962: here 'let there be light' and 'first there was a point' are one event. From the 2026-08-27 conversation on beginnings.
first_phosphor.label: First Phosphor

wooden_pallet.name: Wooden Pallet
wooden_pallet.description: A wooden block/EUR shipping pallet stacked with cardboard boxes — warehouse / logistics vocabulary. Pale-timber slatted deck on stringer-block feet (forklift gaps on the sides), carrying greyish-kraft boxes sealed with packing tape and marked with red FRAGILE tape, black this-way-up arrows, a barcode and a shipping label. box_arrangement stacks them: single, pair (two side by side), or pyramid (two plus one on top — the canonical loaded pallet).

Both are visible in a single still, which a rate or a lag would not be - bond=gyre's turn is, which is why it stays a knob rather than becoming a motion axis. HEIGHT IS THE CRITICAL PARAMETER AND IT IS CLAMPED, not warned about: height_m is clamped to clearance (default 4.40) because the museum builds nothing above the 4.90 m ceiling slab and its soffit is at 4.64, so an unclamped 10 m pillar is a pillar through the ceiling. predicted_degeneracy.pair: mono against courses, in the wash reading
predicted_degeneracy.arithmetic:
REGISTERED BEFORE ANY CAPTURE, and by enumerating all 190 pairs of the 5x4 grid rather than reasoning along one axis. THE BUILD BEING PREDICTED is the bench default: columns=1, rows=1, bond=stacked, footer=true, height_m 4.20 clamped by clearance 4.40, girth 0.80, course_m 0.55. So body = 4.20 - 0.40 = 3.80 m, n = round(3.80/0.55) = 7 courses of uh = 0.5429 m, and ONE COURSE IS 1/7 = 14.3% OF THE INK - already three times the critic's hottest-5% window, which is what makes the statistic a peak delta rather than a mean.

THE TONE TERM. base (0.72,0.68,0.58), accent (0.86,0.28,0.18). mono paints all 7 courses base; courses paints the odd three at base.lerp(accent,0.65) = (0.809,0.420,0.313), a per-channel |delta| of (0.089,0.260,0.267), mean 0.2037. Three courses = 42.9% of the ink overfills the window, so focus = 0.2037 * 0.77 (the lighting-and-tonemap compression the substance_room replica measured) = 15.68%. Registered at 15.7.

WHY IT IS THE FLOOR. Every other wash pair reaches a larger peak because it reaches full base-to-accent or a hue flip: mono/spectrum 22.5, mono/gradient and courses/gradient 24.1 (the top course is pure accent against pure base), courses/spectrum 33.8, gradient/spectrum 34.2. And every stock pair flips silhouette against the corner background, which at a conservative 0.27 albedo contrast is 20.8% wherever the flipped area clears the 5% window - which it always does: the projected silhouette XOR is 24.8% of the subject for the closest stock pair (drum against ball, the ellipses inscribed in the drum's rectangle: 0.760 of 3.067 screen m2 at yaw 0.62 / pitch -0.26, where a circular plan of diameter g projects to width exactly g because the screen basis vector (0.8139, 0.5810) is unit), and 28.0 / 35.7 / 38.0 / 39.1 / 45.9 / 50.0 / 79.0 / 79.3% for the rest.

So the quietest pair in the whole sheet is a WASH pair, at every one of the five stocks, at the same 15.68 - which is itself a check: if the five mono-against-courses numbers are not equal to within render noise, the stocks are not sharing a silhouette and something is moving that should not.

THE TWO WAYS THIS CAN BE WRONG. (a) BELOW 15.7: the standing rule says stop and investigate, and the first suspects are the ones that have cost a pass each - check_dna_declarations first, then <out>/_rejects.json (a String enum handed an int is refused in SILENCE), then whether _read_metadata_overrides actually reassigned the property. Every prediction in this corpus that named a pair and a number has UNDER-read by 1.5x to 6.7x, because a flat-shaded proxy models no shadow, no AO and no antialiasing; a result under its own floor has meant a broken artifact, not a subtle one. (b) FAR ABOVE, say past 45: the courses wash is landing somewhere other than alternate courses - most likely i%2 running over the field index instead of the course index, which would recolour whole stacks and read as a much bigger change than the design makes.

dna.default: cordon=cones is a no-op. _build_scene still lays the ground with the hole, then places three traffic cones (same TAU/3 spacing, same PI/6 offset, same cone_distance, same rotation.y = angle + PI, same trafficcone.tscn), then builds the four ground collision boxes, in that order; the only change is that the cone call now sits behind `match cordon:` with cones as the first case and the export default. All 10 placements (10 direct interactable tokens in 10 maps by direct count, none of which passes a config key, plus one curation_station bay that names it in an artifacts list) are unchanged. apply_grid_config is NEW and reads exactly one key: it returns before touching anything unless `cordon` is present AND names a different value than the one already built - which matters because curation_station places this artifact in an Ontological-distance bay and calls apply_grid_config with framing keys this object has never heard of.
dna.was: four exported floats - ground size, hole radius, ground colour, cone distance - no apply_grid_config at all, so every config key a map could send was silently discarded, and the warning was welded to the pit: three cones or three cones.
dna.note: The hole is the artifact; the cones are the SPEECH ACT about the hole, and they were fused to it. A hazard is not what is missing but what the surrounding matter has been made to announce, and the object could make only one announcement. cones is the shipped site: portable, provisional, stackable, a warning that expects to be taken away again. tape draws the perimeter and stops nobody - a line, not an obstacle, the rest left to your judgement. barrier is the warning become a wall: it no longer addresses your judgement, it removes the choice, and safe and permitted stop being separate things. none is the control case - the danger entirely real and saying nothing, the floor reading as floor until you are in it, which is what proves the other four were speech rather than geometry. covered is the most common answer on a real site and the most double-edged: the pit is not declared but sealed, the ground reads whole, and the absence has been made invisible rather than safe. Marking and concealing turn out to be the same gesture taken one step further.
dna.kin: `warning` (force_vortex, path_cube, path_wedge and eight more: none|stain|cage|beacon|shroud) asks this exact question and was declined, because the list cannot transfer character for character: the shipped default here is a specific piece of real-world equipment, cones, which is not in that list, and the default has to reproduce the pre-change behaviour. Taking the word with a different list would put two incompatible value sets behind one name, which is the state `presence` got into. `guard` (library_rack, exhibit_vitrine, exhibit_furniture: none|label|fixture|hood|cordon) holds cordon as one of its VALUES, a vitrine's barrier among four other things a display can do; here the cordon is the whole speech act rather than one option inside it, so it is the axis name. Nearest in spirit is you_are_here's `deixis`, promoted the same day - both artifacts are about what a sign claims - and the values deliberately do not rhyme, because one addresses a body and the other marks a pit.
dna.harness_note: The subject is a 4 m ground plane and the cordon occupies the middle metre of it, so a whole-AABB fit will dilute the difference; if the tiles read faint, crop to the middle before calling the axis inert - none and cones differ by three cones on an otherwise identical 4 m square. covered is the one value that also changes the ground reading (the pit disappears) and is therefore the strongest tile; barrier is the next. tape and barrier carry no collision by design - they are declarations, and the artifact has always been an environment piece you can walk through the props of - while covered DOES add a collision plate, because a picture of sealed ground that you fall through would be lying in one sense and telling the truth in the other.

eleven_dots.name: Eleven Dots
eleven_dots.description: Max Wertheimer's array, built in a room. Eleven small matte spheres stand in the air with nothing drawn between them, and from a marked spot on the floor 3.2 m away they read unmistakably as a cross. Wertheimer's subjects reported the cross first and had to be asked twice before they counted the dots — evidence, he argued, that the whole arrives before the parts, against Mach's accumulation of discrete sense-atoms and alongside Ehrenfels on melody. The dots are NOT coplanar: each is slid along the ray from the mark through its place in the figure, so the cross is exact from the mark and sheared from anywhere else, which is what makes walking in dissolve the figure rather than merely enlarge it. The default depth (0.55 m across a 2.4 m figure) is deliberately modest — a bit under half the 0.40 m dot pitch of lateral shear at 35 degrees off-axis, so the cross survives a still while visibly not being flat. Turn it up and the figure exists only at the mark. #figure switches the demonstration: cross (proximity and continuation), square (eleven dots on a twelve-slot perimeter, the twelfth left out, and the eye closes it — that is closure, a different law), none (the control, seeded, in the cross's own bounding box). The dots have no colliders by default, because a visitor has to be able to walk into the field and because a point is position without extension. The primitives sequence opens by claiming exactly that; this is the objection standing next to it.

measurements.source: procedural, defaults: cross of 11 at spread_m 2.4 (0.40 m pitch), depth_m 0.55, dot_radius_m 0.05, mark at stand_distance_m 3.2 toward +Z

dev_themes: a point is position without extension
what you see is a fact about where you stand
eleven_dots.qfep_connection: The primitives arc opens on the point as position without extension — a definition that puts everything real in the parts and nothing in the arrangement. Eleven Dots is the counter-case standing in the same corridor: the cross is not in any dot, not between any two dots, and not anywhere in the room. It is produced by a body at a particular place, and it leaves when the body does. Reading the figure is not passive reception of what is there; it is something the visitor DOES, and the same eleven objects support a different truth from two metres to the left.
eleven_dots.note: ADDED 2026-09-09. THE ORIGIN IS THE FLOOR at the centre of the dot field — place the token on the DOT cell; the standing mark eats floor at +Z, toward the approach, which is what clearance.front is for. Config keys, every numeric one drawn from CONFIG_PARAM_NAMES because GridInteractablesComponent.gd:1705 reads an unlisted #key:<number> as the tutorial's positional shorthand: #figure:cross|square|none · #count:11 · #size:2.4 (figure height, alias #width) · #depth:0.55 (0 = coplanar) · #radius:0.05 · #outer:3.2 (metres to the mark) · #mark:false · #solid:true · #color1:e6e4dc (six hex digits, NO leading # — the token is split on # before it is parsed, so #color1:#e6e4dc loses the value entirely). Booleans must take WORD values — #solid:0 is a lone numeric on an unlisted key and is eaten as a rotation. eye_height_m is intentionally NOT reachable from a token: #height: means 'how tall is the thing' everywhere else in this corpus. No dna.axes block: the figure knob is a real family but nothing has swept or bitten it yet, and #figure:none is the honest control that a sweep would need. REVIEWED 2026-09-09: auto_ground is false because the dots are SUPPOSED to hang — with the mark painted the AABB base is 0.006 and auto-ground is a no-op inside its own 0.01 tolerance, but under #mark:false the lowest geometry is the lowest dot at 0.395 and the grid would drop the whole field by that much, eating the 0.12 m floor clearance and pulling the solved standpoint down under a standing visitor. Verified min_y 0.006 (mark) / 0.395 (dots) against the defaults; aabb_size re-measured to [1.74, 2.94, 3.82].
eleven_dots.label: Eleven Dots
